verdict.rationale: Hyperbrowser documents its own isolated execution surfaces: Sandboxes with sub-50ms startup that run arbitrary commands, and sessions that are isolated cloud browser instances. These give agents somewhere to experiment apart from other environments, but they are compute products rather than a documented test or staging mode for the API. Missing for 10: a documented test/sandbox mode or test API keys separate from the production account, assurance that sandbox use cannot touch production data or credits, and independent corroboration.
